blurb: Guests can rent jet skis and boats, take dolphin watch tours, and enjoy banana boat rides. The company operates multiple locations with large riding areas and offers private or semi-private tours. They have over 50 jet skis and various boats including dolphin cruise boats and pirate cruise boats.

quotes.author: Joe T.
quotes.text: It was a great experience for our entire family celebrating my wife's birthday. The company was GREAT to work with and Shawn was very responsive to my requests. All of his staff was very professional and focused on providing exceptional customer service. Can't wait to go again. I highly recommend using them.

quotes.author: Gary G.
quotes.text: Wow! What a blast! My guide was Pete. He did a great job teaching an old guy how to use a jet ski for the first time. Cruising up Little River was fun and then going out into the ocean to see the dolphins and other sights was AMAZING 😎 Highly recommended.

quotes.author: Wendy B.
quotes.text: If you are on the fence about this or nervous because you’ve never ridden a jet ski, just do it!! This was so much fun. For first timers on a jet ski, our tour guide, Zach, was amazing. The hour was a blast and there is no doubt, we will be back!

quotes.author: Erin S.
quotes.text: We had a great time on our pontoon! Fiona and the rest of the staff were so helpful. My older sons and their friends were having a blast on the jet skis. It was the best way to spend some family time and have some water fun! Thank you so much!

quotes.author: Dominique B.
quotes.text: As a first time experience I loved every minute of this place. From the staff down to length of the ride, I highly recommend this to anyone who wants to find a guaranteed spot where minor wind doesn’t affect your experience.

quotes.author: Ma A.
quotes.text: Great place. It was our first time jet skiing, and it was an amazing experience, Jerry, Eddie, Elisha, and Ryan were really nice and awesome people. They made sure we had a great time and that we were safe.

quotes.author: Craig B.
quotes.text: We rented a Jeep from here for our vacation. Owner and staff are great and accommodating. Great customer service and great experience. I would recommend to anyone visiting Myrtle Beach.

We had so much fun! Our guides Ryan and Tristan were amazing! So patient with us. They made sure we had the best experience. We felt comfortable with the process right away. Was my favorite part of the trip!
